en.question: What is Kopi Dua Darjat?
en.answer: Kopi Dua Darjat is a local coffee brand focused on quality brews, community vibes, and meaningful café experiences.

ms.question: Apakah itu Kopi Dua Darjat?
ms.answer: Kopi Dua Darjat ialah jenama kopi tempatan yang menekankan kualiti minuman, komuniti, dan pengalaman kafe yang bermakna.

en.question: Where are your outlets located?
en.answer: Our outlets are located in selected areas and continue to expand across Malaysia.

ms.question: Di manakah lokasi cawangan anda?
ms.answer: Cawangan kami terletak di kawasan terpilih dan sedang berkembang di seluruh Malaysia.

en.question: Do you offer takeaway and dine-in?
en.answer: Yes, all our outlets offer both takeaway and dine-in options.

ms.question: Adakah anda menawarkan bawa pulang dan makan di kedai?
ms.answer: Ya, semua cawangan kami menawarkan pilihan bawa pulang dan makan di kedai.

en.question: Do you provide Wi-Fi at your outlets?
en.answer: Most of our outlets provide free Wi-Fi for customers.

ms.question: Adakah Wi-Fi disediakan?
ms.answer: Kebanyakan cawangan kami menyediakan Wi-Fi percuma untuk pelanggan.

en.question: Are your cafés family-friendly?
en.answer: Yes, our cafés are designed to be comfortable and welcoming for all ages.

ms.question: Adakah kafe anda mesra keluarga?
ms.answer: Ya, kafe kami direka supaya selesa dan mesra untuk semua peringkat umur.

en.question: What type of coffee do you serve?
en.answer: We serve a variety of espresso-based drinks and signature local-inspired coffee.

ms.question: Apakah jenis kopi yang disediakan?
ms.answer: Kami menyediakan pelbagai minuman berasaskan espresso dan kopi istimewa berinspirasikan tempatan.

en.question: Do you offer non-coffee drinks?
en.answer: Yes, we also offer chocolate, tea, and other non-coffee beverages.

ms.question: Adakah terdapat minuman bukan kopi?
ms.answer: Ya, kami juga menawarkan coklat, teh, dan minuman bukan kopi yang lain.

en.question: Are your ingredients halal?
en.answer: Yes, all ingredients used are halal-certified or sourced responsibly.

ms.question: Adakah bahan-bahan anda halal?
ms.answer: Ya, semua bahan yang digunakan adalah halal atau diperoleh secara bertanggungjawab.

en.question: Do you have seasonal menu items?
en.answer: Yes, we introduce seasonal and limited-time menu items regularly.

ms.question: Adakah menu bermusim disediakan?
ms.answer: Ya, kami memperkenalkan menu bermusim dan edisi terhad secara berkala.

en.question: Can I customize my drink?
en.answer: Yes, you can customize sweetness level, milk options, and add-ons.

ms.question: Bolehkah saya menyesuaikan minuman?
ms.answer: Ya, anda boleh menyesuaikan tahap manis, jenis susu, dan tambahan lain.

en.question: Does Kopi Dua Darjat offer franchise opportunities?
en.answer: Yes, we welcome partners who share our vision to grow together.

ms.question: Adakah Kopi Dua Darjat menawarkan francais?
ms.answer: Ya, kami mengalu-alukan rakan kongsi yang berkongsi visi untuk berkembang bersama.

en.question: What is the initial investment for a franchise?
en.answer: The investment depends on outlet size and location. Contact us for details.

ms.question: Berapakah pelaburan awal untuk francais?
ms.answer: Pelaburan bergantung kepada saiz dan lokasi cawangan. Hubungi kami untuk maklumat lanjut.

en.question: Do you provide training for franchise partners?
en.answer: Yes, we provide full operational and barista training.

ms.question: Adakah latihan disediakan untuk rakan francais?
ms.answer: Ya, kami menyediakan latihan operasi dan barista sepenuhnya.

en.question: Will marketing support be provided?
en.answer: Yes, franchise partners receive branding and marketing support.

ms.question: Adakah sokongan pemasaran disediakan?
ms.answer: Ya, rakan francais menerima sokongan penjenamaan dan pemasaran.

en.question: Can I choose my outlet location?
en.answer: Location selection is evaluated together to ensure brand consistency and success.

ms.question: Bolehkah saya memilih lokasi cawangan?
ms.answer: Pemilihan lokasi dinilai bersama bagi memastikan kejayaan dan konsistensi jenama.
